race.description: Ladbrokes Flex Your Multi Stays Alive Pace
race.comment: KYRGIOS (1) ran fifth last start at Hobart over 2090m, beaten 22 metres. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Meets a similar line up, and he is the one to beat this time. MIKI SANZ (3) finished second last time out, beaten a neck, in a nice return to form at this track over 2200m. Has the benefit of a good draw. Recent efforts are good enough to win a race of this calibre. PARK LANE NZ (5) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish third at Hobart over 1609m. Genuine threat. JAY MILLER (2) has a suitable draw, and is worth some thought based on his second over 2200m at this track two runs ago.
